content.title: Bitwise Parity Compression
content.problemStatement: You are given a stream of 8-bit sensor telemetry packets. For each integer in array A, compute the bitwise XOR sum of its popcount and its parity mask. Let S be the sum of all computed values modulo 100. Return S as a 2-digit number (zero-padded if < 10).

content.title: Graph Latency Bottleneck
content.problemStatement: Given a directed weighted network graph with 6 nodes representing core switches, calculate the critical path bottleneck value from node 1 to node 6. Let B be the maximum latency edge along the shortest path. Compute B % 100.

content.title: Prefix Sum Inversion Count
content.problemStatement: In an execution trace of thread identifiers [9, 1, 8, 2, 7, 3, 6, 4, 5], calculate the number of inversions (pairs (i, j) where i < j and A[i] > A[j]). Output the inversion count modulo 100.

content.title: Binary Matrix Island Perimeter
content.problemStatement: Given a 6x6 memory buffer represented as a binary matrix where 1 represents an allocated sector and 0 is free space, calculate the total perimeter of all connected allocation clusters (isolated edges touching 0 or boundary). Output total perimeter % 100.

content.title: Matrix Chain Scalar Multiplication Cost
content.problemStatement: Determine the minimal number of scalar multiplications needed to multiply a sequence of 4 matrices with dimensions: A1: 10x30, A2: 30x5, A3: 5x60, A4: 60x10. Calculate (minimal_scalar_multiplications / 50) % 100.

content.title: Stack-Based Syntax Parser Checksum
content.problemStatement: Evaluate the token stream with nested scopes: "{ [ ( [ ] ) ] { [ ] } ( ) }". For each token pair, multiply the nesting depth by the bracket type weight ({} = 3, [] = 2, () = 1). Sum all products and take modulo 100.

content.title: Off-By-One Buffer Parser & Pointer Arithmetic
content.problemStatement: The following telemetry parser has an off-by-one pointer slip and an uninitialized accumulator flaw. It fails to correctly compute the checksum of the message payload "C//L-ALPHA-7729". Fix the bug in the provided code and run it with the input payload. What is the resulting 3-digit checksum output?
content.outputDescription: Exact 3-digit integer produced by the fixed program.

content.title: Integer Overflow & Boundary Comparator Bug
content.problemStatement: The following interval scheduler produces incorrect scheduling weights due to signed 16-bit integer truncation and incorrect strictly-greater comparator logic. Fix the broken comparator and variable typing. When fed with the task sequence, find the corrected 3-digit schedule metric.
content.outputDescription: Exact 3-digit integer produced by the fixed code.
content.starterCode:
# BROKEN INTERVAL SCHEDULER (Python)
def solve_schedule(intervals):
    # BUG 1: sorting by start time instead of end time for greedy interval scheduling
    # BUG 2: improper overlap condition allows colliding intervals
    sorted_tasks = sorted(intervals, key=lambda x: x[0])
    
    last_end = 0
    total_metric = 0
    
    for start, end, weight in sorted_tasks:
        # BUG: should be start >= last_end
        if start > last_end:
            total_metric = (total_metric + weight * 7) % 1000
            last_end = end
            
    # Normalize to 3-digit code
    return total_metric

tasks = [(1, 5, 120), (3, 7, 250), (6, 12, 410), (8, 14, 180), (10, 15, 330)]
print(solve_schedule(tasks))

content.title: The Core Reactor Lock: Synchronized Extraction
content.problemStatement:
The final CODE//LOCK system requires complete team collaboration.
Each role possesses a fragmented sub-key derived from the event matrix:

[ROLE FRAGMENTS]
1. THINKER: Decodes the cipher matrix shift pattern:
   Matrix A: [5, 9, 2, 8] with base modulus 7. Result = 3

2. CODER: Executes the algorithmic permutation transform:
   Rotate binary key 0b10110011 left by 3 bits, XOR with 0xAA. Result = 9

3. DEBUGGER: Repairs the corrupted parity checksum in trace #409:
   Fixed checksum value = 07

4. SUPPORTER: Assembles the master sequence in strict order:
   Assemble: THINKER_CODE (1 char) + CODER_CODE (1 char) + DEBUGGER_CODE (2 chars) + CONTROL_SALT "42"
   Resulting in the 6-character Master Unlock Sequence: "390742"

Solve the four role challenges on your team sheet and combine them to generate the 6-character Final Master Unlock Code.
